From 30d5297862410418bb8f8b4c0a87fa55c3063dd7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Thomas=20Wei=C3=9Fschuh?= <linux@weissschuh.net>
Date: Sun, 4 Feb 2024 18:30:43 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] power: supply: mm8013: select REGMAP_I2C
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The driver uses regmap APIs so it should make sure they are available.

Fixes: c75f4bf6800b ("power: supply: Introduce MM8013 fuel gauge driver")
Cc:  <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Weißschuh <linux@weissschuh.net>
Reviewed-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240204-mm8013-regmap-v1-1-7cc6b619b7d3@weissschuh.net
Signed-off-by: Sebastian Reichel <sebastian.reichel@collabora.com>

diff --git a/drivers/power/supply/Kconfig b/drivers/power/supply/Kconfig
index f21cb05815ec..3e31375491d5 100644
--- a/drivers/power/supply/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/power/supply/Kconfig
@@ -978,6 +978,7 @@ config CHARGER_QCOM_SMB2
 config FUEL_GAUGE_MM8013
 	tristate "Mitsumi MM8013 fuel gauge driver"
 	depends on I2C
+	select REGMAP_I2C
 	help
 	  Say Y here to enable the Mitsumi MM8013 fuel gauge driver.
 	  It enables the monitoring of many battery parameters, including
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/power/supply/Kconfig`**
   - Added the line `select REGMAP_I2C` under the configuration option for `FUEL_GAUGE_MM8013`. This change ensures that the REGMAP_I2C functionality is selected when the MM8013 fuel gauge driver is enabled.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the `Kconfig` file establishes a dependency relationship where the MM8013 fuel gauge driver now explicitly requires the REGMAP_I2C support to be available. This is necessary because the driver utilizes regmap APIs, and selecting REGMAP_I2C ensures that these APIs are accessible, thereby fixing the issue identified in the previous commit (c75f4bf6800b). This change enhances the robustness of the driver by ensuring that all necessary components are included when the driver is compiled.

Cc:  <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Weißschuh <linux@weissschuh.net>
Reviewed-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@linaro.org>

Here is the root cause:
The MM8013 fuel gauge driver relies on regmap APIs for its functionality, but it did not have a proper dependency on REGMAP_I2C in its configuration. This oversight could lead to compilation issues or runtime errors if the necessary regmap support was not available when the driver was enabled.
